exposure: Provision of extra blood sample (proxy for alcohol use)
outcome: Representativeness of sample characteristics (age, BMI, deprivation, pregnancy history, smoking status, self-reported alcohol use, gestational age at birth, birth weight)
cohort: 4049 pregnant women in the study city
finding: Passive consent for an extra blood sample, without disclosing its use for alcohol biomarker testing, resulted in high participation and reduced bias, with those providing samples being more likely to report alcohol consumption.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth was measured as an outcome
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured as an outcome
